title: fix: validate community model streams
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Streams existing text probes without adding requests
- Rejects malformed JSON, invalid chunk shapes, missing or unterminated [DONE], and post-terminal data
- Keeps streamed usage reconciliation and marker validation
- Alerts only after the same protocol error repeats twice; never rewrites provider output

Tests:
- Local fake-server matrix: LF/CRLF, malformed JSON, missing [DONE], missing separator, and post-terminal data
- Live targeted probes: valid community stream passed; known malformed Sharktide stream returned PROTOCOL

gist.headline: Streams get inspected
gist.blurb: The community monitor now reads text streams all the way to the final buzz. It can spot malformed chunks without poking providers with extra requests.
gist.summary: Updated the community model monitor to validate existing streamed text probes for malformed JSON, invalid chunk shapes, missing or unterminated [DONE] markers, and data sent after the terminal marker.
gist.impact: Provider stream protocol issues are now detected more reliably, with alerts sent only after the same error occurs twice and without modifying provider output.
gist.visual_concept: A careful stream-inspection scene: Polli acts as a tiny protocol librarian, following a glowing terminal stream through a garden-like pipeline toward a clear [DONE] sign. Small malformed pixel packets are gently caught in a net, while healthy stream packets flow onward; this represents validation without rewriting provider output.
